$comment: GENERATED from tools/cfgschema by tools/cfgdoc - do not edit; make config-docs regenerates it
title: ecu.toml
description: blobly_emb ECU configuration: partitions, threads, Function Blocks, signals, buses and services of one node

import.description: the DBC the node's CAN signals come from

trace.description: the trace ring and its dump protocol (docs/telemetry.md)

shell.description: the command shell over CAN or SOME/IP

nm.description: network management: the module's endpoint bindings and timings

nvm.description: the NvM journal: persisted signals and its wear check (docs/nvm.md)

target.description: what the node is built for: host (absent), bare metal or ThreadX

someip.description: the SOME/IP service identity and static endpoints (docs/someip.md)

bus.description: the node's buses, one [bus.<name>] each; signals and frames name them

partition.description: memory-protection partitions, each pinned to a core with its threads

fb.description: Function Blocks: the application, scheduled on a thread

signal.description: typed signals between partitions and to/from buses

frame.description: per-frame COM settings: tx mode, rx deadline, E2E, SecOC (CAN), or a SOME/IP event (eth)

isotp.description: ISO 15765-2: the diagnostic server on CAN

uds.description: ISO 14229: the node's one diagnostic server

doip.description: the diagnostic server over DoIP too (ThreadX target)

boot.description: the node runs behind the bootloader: 0x10 02 hands over to it (docs/bootloader.md)

display.description: a local screen: one more ThreadX thread (docs/display.md)

fault_memory.description: the fault memory's operation cycle and snapshot entries

route.description: gateway routes: raw frames or decoded signals between buses

dbc.description: the DBC comm matrix, relative to the node (read for provenance; generation takes the DBC on its command line)

telemetry.title: [telemetry]
telemetry.description: The CPU-load transmitter (CpuLoad, LoadDetail); [trace] and [shell] take its bus when they name none.

enabled.description: transmit load telemetry (a ThreadX target needs it on, with a bus) Default: false.

bus.description: the CAN bus the load frames ride

detail_id.description: the LoadDetail frame's CAN id; absent = not sent

trace.title: [trace]
trace.description: The trace ring and its dump protocol (docs/telemetry.md). A present block is on unless enabled = false.

enabled.description: generate the trace (present = on) Default: true.

bus.description: the CAN bus for its command / response / dump frames; absent = [telemetry].bus

level.description: which records are captured: FB, thread and ISR switches Default: "thread+fb".

buffer_records.description: the ring depth in 8-byte records (the dump is multi-block) Default: 64.

mode.description: ring = a flight recorder frozen by a trigger or stop; oneshot = fill once Default: "ring".

pre_pct.description: the percentage of the ring kept from before the trigger Default: 50.

push_ms.description: the HandlerStat heartbeat period (ms; 0 = off) Default: 1000.

cmd.description: the TraceCmd frame: arm / stop / reset / dump / status Default: 0x7E2.

record.description: the dump stream frame (raw records, or ISO-TP blocks) Default: 0x7E5.

dump_fc.description: the dump's ISO-TP flow control; binding it selects the block dump Default: 0x7E6.

trigger.description: what freezes the ring; absent = no trigger

trigger.title: [trace.trigger]
trigger.description: What freezes the ring. Only source = "overrun" is generated today; the other keys are the design's (docs/telemetry.md).

source.description: the trigger kind (required when the table is present)

signal.description: design only: the signal to watch

address.description: design only: the partition-local address to poll

when.description: design only: the condition on the watched value

pre.description: design only (the implemented split is [trace] pre_pct)

budget_us.description: source = "overrun": freeze when a handler runs longer than this (µs)

shell.title: [shell]
shell.description: The command shell: a command line in, its response out, over CAN or as a SOME/IP method.

enabled.description: generate the shell (present = on) Default: true.

bus.description: the bus its frames ride; absent = [telemetry].bus

in.description: the frame a command line arrives on (1..8 bytes) Default: 0x7F0.

out.description: the frame the response leaves on (one ISO-TP block) Default: 0x7F1.

fc.description: the ISO-TP flow control for the response Default: 0x7F2.

commands.description: example-provided target commands (shell_<name> in target_ext.c), each 1..8 of [a-z0-9_] Default: [].

method.description: eth: the SOME/IP method id the command line rides (required there)

allow_mutate.description: the REQ-NET-018 access gate: false exposes only read-class commands over eth Default: false.

nm.title: [nm]
nm.description: Network management (comm/nm_can). The scalar keys are the module's endpoint bindings and timings.

enabled.description: generate the NM module; default true when [nm] has scalar keys

bus.description: the CAN bus NM runs on; absent = [telemetry].bus

node.description: this ECU's NM source node id (required when NM is generated)

pn.description: the partial networks this node requests (bitmask) Default: 0.

request.description: request the bus from boot Default: true.

msg_cycle_ms.description: the NM message period while awake (ms) Default: 100.

repeat_ms.description: the repeat-message phase after a wake (ms) Default: 200.

alive.description: this node's NM frame (DBC name or id); default peers lo + node

peers.description: [lo, hi] — the cluster's NM frame ids Default: [0x500, 0x53F].

nm_net.title: [nm.*]
nm_net.description: The LEGACY per-network NM block (cfg2v's gen.nm_<bus>_* constants), beside the module bindings of [nm].

tx_id.description: this node's NM tx id Default: 0.

rx_lo.description: the NM rx id range's low bound (required by cfg2v)

rx_hi.description: the NM rx id range's high bound (required by cfg2v)

pn_local.description: the partial networks requested statically (48-bit mask) Default: 0.

nvm.title: [nvm]
nvm.description: The NvM journal: persisted signals, and the wear check that proves it outlives the vehicle (docs/nvm.md).

enabled.description: declare the journal; default true when [nvm] has a key besides `assume`

min_write_ms.description: the system-wide write floor pacing persist = "now" writes (ms) Default: 1000.

sector_records.description: a journal sector in records (the wear check's geometry) Default: 4096.

endurance.description: flash erase cycles per sector Default: 10000.

min_years.description: the lifetime the journal must reach at the assumed rates Default: 10.

assume.description: the vehicle's rates the wear check takes

nvm_assume.title: [nvm.assume]
nvm_assume.description: Vehicle usage rates the wear check assumes, per day.

cycles_per_day.description: operation cycles: NM wake -> sleep, or power-ups Default: 144.

target.title: [target]
target.description: What the node is built for; absent = the host (POSIX) build.

someip.title: [someip]
someip.description: The SOME/IP service identity and static endpoints (docs/someip.md). Deliberately no `instance`: without SD nothing on the wire carries it.

bus.description: the eth bus it binds to

version.description: the interface version byte, explicitly managed

peer.description: address:port — the tx destination AND the rx source filter

bus.title: [bus.*]
bus.description: One of the node's buses: a CAN channel or the eth interface.

interface.description: the platform interface (e.g. "vcan0"), or on eth the node's static IPv4 address

fd.description: open the channel as CAN-FD Default: false.

core.description: the core the bus bridge runs on Default: 0.

kind.description: "can", or "eth" (SOME/IP, docs/someip.md; at most one) Default: "can".

dbc.description: a per-bus DBC (a multi-bus GATEWAY speaks more than one contract)

partition.title: [[partition]]
partition.description: A memory-protection partition, pinned to a core, with its threads.

core.description: the core index it is pinned to (required)

trusted.description: privileged: the MPU domain with peripheral / IO access Default: false.

external.description: declared but hand-written: a satellite core's image built elsewhere Default: false.

image.description: emit this partition's image into this directory (docs/multi-image.md; ThreadX)

thread.title: [[partition.thread]]
thread.description: A thread; an fb names it to run there.

fb.title: [[fb]]
fb.description: A Function Block: the application unit, scheduled on one thread.

handler.title: [[fb.handler]]
handler.description: A handler: an FB entry point the Loom dispatches.

period_ms.description: the period it runs at (ms; the trigger, required)

irq.description: reserved: an interrupt trigger, refused until it is generated

reads.description: the signals (and params) it reads Default: [].

signal.title: [[signal]]
signal.description: A typed signal from one endpoint to another: a partition, a thread, a bus, or "io".

name.description: PascalCase; a signal a bus carries takes its DBC name

fields.description: field name -> type, the signal's struct

from.description: the producer: a partition, thread, bus or "io"

to.description: the consumer: a partition, thread, bus or "io"

transport.description: the IOC buffer between partitions (derived for io signals); the hardware ones are target backends, double on host Default: "double".

persist.description: keep it in NvM: write-through, or flush at sleep — intent, not tuning (docs/nvm.md)

nvm_id.description: pins the NvM record id (0 = derived; only to resolve a reported collision) Default: 0.

frame.title: [[frame]]
frame.description: Per-frame COM settings. CAN: the DBC message `name` and its tx / rx / E2E / SecOC. eth: a SOME/IP event, its id and signals.

name.description: CAN: the DBC message; eth: the event (PascalCase)

id.description: eth: the SOME/IP event id (required there; CAN ids come from the DBC)

signals.description: eth: its member signals; the payload layout is derived from them

peer.description: eth: this event's own address:port, when not [someip].peer

e2e.description: AUTOSAR E2E Profile 1 (the DBC's E2E attributes otherwise)

mode.description: periodic, on a change, both, or on an explicit trigger (eth: not triggered) Default: "cyclic".

cycle_ms.description: the period of a cyclic or mixed frame (ms; CAN: a multiple of 10) Default: 100.

min_delay_ms.description: the least gap between two event sends (ms) Default: 0.

timeout_ms.description: the reception deadline (ms; 0 = none); past it the signal status is timeout Default: 0.

e2e.title: inline e2e
e2e.description: AUTOSAR E2E Profile 1. Each key defaults to the DBC's E2E attribute; a differing value needs deviates_from_dbc.

data_id.description: the Data ID mixed into the CRC

counter_pos.description: the byte whose low nibble holds the counter

timeout_ms.description: rx: the E2E-owned sender-loss timeout (ms; REQ-E2E-002)

deviates_from_dbc.description: a field above that differs from the DBC's E2E attributes is deliberate Default: false.

secoc.title: inline secoc
secoc.description: SecOC: a truncated AES-128 CMAC and a freshness value in the frame.

key.description: the AES-128 key, 16 space-separated hex bytes (required)

data_id.description: the Data ID bound into the MAC Default: 0.

isotp.title: [isotp]
isotp.description: The diagnostic server's ISO 15765-2 connection on CAN (docs/diagnostics.md).

bus.description: the CAN bus ([bus.*] name) the connection runs on

rx_id.description: the CAN id physical requests arrive on (11-bit)

tx_id.description: the CAN id responses are sent on (11-bit)

bs.description: the block size granted in our Flow Control (0 = the whole message at once) Default: 0.

stmin_ms.description: the STmin (ms) we ask a sender to keep between consecutive frames Default: 0.

functional_id.description: the functional (broadcast) request id, e.g. 0x7DF, single frames only; absent = none

uds.title: [uds]
uds.description: The node's one ISO 14229 diagnostic server: session and security timing, the 0x27 key, the service table.

s3_ms.description: the session timeout back to the default session (ms; 0 = the default) Default: 5000.

security_attempts.description: wrong 0x27 keys before the lockout (0 = the default) Default: 3.

security_delay_ms.description: the 0x27 lockout delay after too many wrong keys (ms; 0 = the default) Default: 10000.

security_key.description: "reference" = blobly_net's PUBLIC bench key (a target); absent = the OEM's diag_sa_key_ok

services.description: the service table, "0xSID" = { ... } ("0x10 02": the [boot] handoff); absent = every service the build performs

uds_service.title: [uds] services row
uds_service.description: One served service: the sessions it is accepted in and the 0x27 level it needs.

sessions.description: the sessions it is accepted in; absent = the service's default sessions

security.description: the 0x27 level that must be unlocked first (0 = none) Default: 0.

doip.title: [doip]
doip.description: The diagnostic server over DoIP (ISO 13400) too — ThreadX target; one parser for this and a system node's `doip` (tools/doipcfg).

address.description: the node's static IPv4 address — a host on its /24 (not .0, .1 or .255)

logical_address.description: the entity's logical address (0x0001..0x0DFF or 0x1000..0x7FFF); unique

functional_address.description: the functional address it also answers Default: 0xE400.

testers.description: tester addresses allowed to activate routing (at most 8); absent = any 0x0E00..0x0FFF

activation_types.description: routing activation types served: 0x00, 0x01, 0xE1..0xFF (at most 4) Default: [0x00].

initial_inactivity_ms.description: T_TCP_Initial_Inactivity: time to activate after the TCP connect (ms); <= general_inactivity_ms Default: 2000.

general_inactivity_ms.description: T_TCP_General_Inactivity: idle timeout once activated (ms) Default: 300000.

announce_count.description: A_DoIP_Announce_Num: vehicle announcements at start-up Default: 3.

announce_interval_ms.description: A_DoIP_Announce_Interval (ms); count x interval at most 10000 ms Default: 500.

allow_bench_key.description: answer 0x27 with blobly_net's PUBLIC reference key over the network — a bench posture, opted into by name Default: false.

boot.title: [boot]
boot.description: The node runs behind the bootloader (docs/bootloader.md).

session_key.description: the 0x29 session PUBLIC key, 64 hex; not the image key

display.title: [display]
display.description: A local screen: one more ThreadX thread (boards/<board>/display.c, docs/display.md).

ui.description: the node's screen (ui_create, ui_update): a C file relative to the node

did.title: [[did]]
did.description: A data identifier the server reads (0x22) and may write (0x2E). Its value is ONE of: `ascii` / `bytes` (a constant), `signal` (live), `param` (a coded [[param]]), `param_status`, `tx_saturations`.

ascii.description: a constant value as an ASCII string (at most 32 bytes)

bytes.description: a constant value as space-separated hex bytes (at most 32)

writable.description: 0x2E may overwrite the constant's RAM copy (implied by `write`) Default: false.

signal.description: a live value: the signal's, refreshed every pass, big-endian at its width; read-only

param.description: the [[param]] this DID codes (0x2E) and reads back (0x22)

param_status.description: one byte per [[param]]: 0 default / 1 coded / 2 reverted Default: false.

tx_saturations.description: the count of sent values saturated to their DBC range since start (u32 BE) Default: false.

read.description: the 0x22 gate; absent = every session, no security

write.description: the 0x2E gate (makes the DID writable); absent = every session, no security

did_access.title: [[did]] read/write
did_access.description: The sessions and the 0x27 level an access needs.

session.description: the sessions it is allowed in; absent = every session

security.description: the 0x27 level that must be unlocked (0 = none) Default: 0.

fault.title: [[fault]]
fault.description: A diagnostic fault: a DTC, the test that sets it and how its results are debounced, confirmed and aged (docs/diagnostics.md §3.3).

name.description: PascalCase, unique; a field of the testing FB's Faults struct

dtc.description: the 3-byte DTC 0x19 reports; unique per server

from.description: "Fb.handler" — the handler that tests it (or `signal` + `on` for a signal-status fault)

signal.description: a signal-status fault: the received signal whose rx status the bridge watches

on.description: a signal-status fault: the rx status that counts as failed

debounce.description: how test results become failed / passed; absent = counter, fail 1, pass 1

enable.description: "Signal.field" bool conditions (read by the handler) that must hold for a result to count Default: [].

confirm.description: failed operation cycles to confirm the DTC Default: 1.

aging.description: passing cycles before a confirmed DTC ages out (0 = never) Default: 0.

freeze.description: the snapshot: [[did]] ids captured at the failure, 0x19 04 (at most 4) Default: [].

priority.description: displacement when the snapshot entries are full: 1 (most important) .. 255 Default: 128.

snapshot_id.description: retired: refused, with the move to `snapshot_ids`

snapshot_ids.description: pins the snapshot's two journal blocks [A, B] (only to resolve a reported collision)

fault_debounce.title: [[fault]] debounce
fault_debounce.description: A counter debounce counts results; a time debounce times them. Each kind takes only its own keys.

kind.description: count results, or time them Default: "counter".

fail_ms.description: time: how long it keeps failing before it is failed (ms; required)

pass_ms.description: time: how long it keeps passing before it is passed (ms; required)

inc.description: counter: the step per failed result Default: 1.

dec.description: counter: the step per passed result Default: 1.

jump.description: counter: reset on a reversal ("N in a row"); default true when fail = 1, else it accumulates

param.title: [[param]]
param.description: A coded parameter (variant coding): a read-only FB input, coded with 0x2E on its [[did]] and kept in the NvM journal (docs/diagnostics.md §3.4).

name.description: PascalCase; the value type the FBs read

fields.description: 1..2 fields, name -> bool / u8 / u16 / u32 / i8 / i16 / i32

default.description: every field's compiled default, within its range — what an uncoded vehicle runs

range.description: per field, the values it may be coded to; absent = the type's

apply.description: when a coded value takes effect: the FB's next dispatch, or the next start Default: "next_dispatch".

version.description: bump when a field's meaning changes but its type does not (stored values revert) Default: 0.

nvm_id.description: pins the journal block (0 = derived; only to resolve a reported collision) Default: 0.

param_range.title: [[param]] range
param_range.description: The coded values one field may take (0x2E answers 0x31 outside it).

min.description: the lowest value (default: the type's minimum)

max.description: the highest value (default: the type's maximum)

fault_memory.title: [fault_memory]
fault_memory.description: The fault memory as a whole.

cycle.description: the operation cycle: a bool "Signal.field", or "power"; absent on a target = NM

entries.description: snapshot entries (default one per fault with `freeze`); fewer = displacement

route.title: [[route]]
route.description: A gateway route: forward a raw frame, or decode a signal and re-encode it (CAN only).

signal.description: a SIGNAL route: decode it on `from`, re-encode it into `to`; absent = a raw frame route

frame.description: the DBC frame to forward / decode
SIGNAL route: the destination DBC frame to re-encode into (required there)

id.description: FRAME route: the id on the destination bus (0 = keep the source id) Default: 0.

io.title: [io]
io.description: Physical IO points (docs/io.md), each bound to the [[signal]] of the same name; at most 32.

core.description: the io thread's home core; every io signal's partition must be on it Default: 0.

adc.description: analog inputs (at most 16, one scan sequence)

io_gpio.title: [[io.gpio]]
io_gpio.description: A digital pin: an input (the signal is from "io") or an output (to "io"), one bool field.

name.description: binds the [[signal]] of the same name

pin.description: the pad, backend-opaque (e.g. "PB0"); one point per pad

period_ms.description: sample (input) or apply (output) period, ms >= 1, a multiple of the fastest io period

init.description: outputs, REQUIRED there: the level held until the FB first publishes

active_low.description: pad polarity: logical true drives the pad LOW Default: false.

default.description: inputs only: the port value before the first real sample Default: false.

io_adc.title: [[io.adc]]
io_adc.description: An analog input bound to a u16/u32 [[signal]] from "io".

period_ms.description: the PUBLISH cadence (ms >= 1); the conversion free-runs

default.description: the count held until the first real sample (within the field type) Default: 0.

io_pwm.title: [[io.pwm]]
io_pwm.description: A PWM output bound to a u16/u32 [[signal]] to "io" carrying duty in permille.

name.description: binds a u16/u32 [[signal]] carrying permille (output only)

init.description: the duty (permille) before the first publish; required on an output

bulk.title: [[bulk]]
bulk.description: A bulk transport pool (docs/bulk-transport.md): a producer/consumer SPSC ring of buffers. Same partition = a per-image arena; different cores = the H755 shared window.

bufsz.description: bytes per buffer, a multiple of 32
